text:
Predicates:
YaleUniversity(x) ::: x is Yale University.
ResearchUniversity(x) ::: x is a research university.
MoveTo(x, y) ::: x moved to y.
ValuedAt(x, y) ::: x is valued at y.
ConstituentCollege(x) ::: x is a constituent college or school of Yale.
ResidentialCollege(x) ::: x is a residential college.
GraduateSchool(x) ::: x is the Yale Graduate School of Arts and Sciences.
ProfessionalSchool(x) ::: x is a professional school.
ListOfResidentialColleges(x) ::: x is the list of Yale's residential colleges.
LargestEndowment(x) ::: x has the largest endowment.
EndowmentValue(x, y) ::: x has an endowment valued at y.
Premises:
YaleUniversity(yale) ∧ ResearchUniversity(yale) ∧ MoveTo(yale, newHaven) ∧ YearMoved(yale, 1716) ∧ Endowment(yale, value) ∧ EndowmentValue(yale, 42.3_billion) ∧ ConstituentCollege(yale, benjaminFranklin) ∧ ConstituentCollege(yale, berkeley) ∧ ConstituentCollege(yale, branford) ∧ ConstituentCollege(yale, davenport) ∧ ConstituentCollege(yale, ezraStiles) ∧ ConstituentCollege(yale, graceHopper) ∧ ConstituentCollege(yale, jonathanEdwards) ∧ ConstituentCollege(yale, morse) ∧ ConstituentCollege(yale, pauliMurray) ∧ ConstituentCollege(yale, pierson) ∧ ConstituentCollege(yale, saybrook) ∧ ConstituentCollege(yale, silliman) ∧ ConstituentCollege(yale, timothyDwight) ∧ ConstituentCollege(yale, trumbull) ::: Yale University is a research university that moved to New Haven in 1716, valued at $42.3 billion, with listed constituent colleges.
LargestEndowment(yaleEndowment) ::: Yale University has the largest university endowment of any educational institution.
Conclusion:
LargestEndowment(yaleEndowment) ::: Yale University has the largest university endowment of any educational institution.
